title: Ancient history in a pleasant and suitable way for all ages
text:
I took this guided tour with two kids. Caesar got them to follow him and be attentive within 5 minutes.
He explained everything very clearly and with many visual supports. Great historical knowledge.
The icing on the cake was the Roman poem.
Thank you for showing us everything in such a pleasant way.
author: Suluna1881

title: Great visit in Seville
text: The visit to Italica has been great, for the Roman monuments and especially thanks to the Guide César León, who has managed to make the visit enjoyable and fun. Thanks to its photographic resources we have been able to understand how this Roman city of Seville was. We recommend it 100%.
